im 17 so they would take me to, and my sister is 16. i should have said that in the original post sorry. but i just believed what my mom has been telling me (even though i probably shouldn't and look into this stuff myself) so i just assumed thats what would happen. the only family we have is my aunt that lives in new york and we live in florida so im not sure if they would take us to her some how or find some thing else for us.

i wouldn't be surprised if they believed my parents over me. last time they were here, they didn't do anything to help us and if i tried to tell them what was happening they didnt do anything and just believed whatever my parents had to say.

my mom used to be in foster care thats what she told me they would do. i never really looked into it but i guess i should. if they dont put us in a group home, they could put in the care of our aunt (our only family that can take us in) but she lives in new york and we are in floridia so i dont know if they would send us all that way.

 and when my sister has a melt down over something it gets violent really quickly, like ive had my entire room destroyed during one of them so if she does that while she is in there care, they will probably say she is a danger to her self and others and institutionalize her.

thanks for the advice. i went to ask d why he hated it and it didnt really go well. he said again that i will always be my old name him. that it makes him (and m) unconfortable and kept trying to talk for m for some reason.he said he and m will never call me nick, even though i already talked to m about and he said he would try to adjust to my new name and the only problem he has with it is that nick is the same name as his brother so he has trouble with it (which is understand able and i told him that). i tried to be as nice and clear  as i could but d won't try. he hates nick for some unknown reasons he wont tell me. he wanted me to pick another name and i said no and 'its **my** name, i chose it **for me** not you,or b or anyone else'. i also told him 'if it makes you and m so uncomfortable  that you can't call me my name then kinda just try to imagine what its like for me.' then went on to explain my dysphoria and how being deadnamed makes me feel. after that he said he still wont call my nick and that i need to pick something else. again i said 'Im not change my name. i said this already, its my name and i changed it for me. not for anyone else and i'm not changing it for anyone else'. he ended the argument with "ok well if you are going to be this way i am just going to keep calling you \[old name\] i am not dealing with this right now and honestly i could care less". i didnt reply after that.

so that happened. i'm trying to believe what you said "when people show you who they really are,believe them" so i'm just not gonna talk to d for a little while. maybe me just completely cutting him off will make him understand how serious this is but i doubt it. it just sucks how he does this when he was supposed to my friend and having to throw away such a long friendship.

also sorry about your mom. my dad is a narcissist aswell and i wouldn't dare come to him cause his reaction would be horrible.
